results.title: MTV VMAs Drop Best Afrobeats Category as Burna Boy, Tems Earn Nods
results.description: The 2026 MTV VMAs have dropped the Best Afrobeats category, with Burna Boy and Tems earning nominations in broader genre categories. Burna Boy received two nods for his collaboration with Shakira, while Tems is nominated in Best R&B for “Raindance” with Dave.
